items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember Nancy Hanks' saloon? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Nancy Hanks.

ctx.x: Do you remember Nancy Hanks' saloon? It was up on that corner too, where Pete Lawless, somebody told me once, I'm not sure. Nancy Hanks.
It was a saloon, but they had music.
